mha_kenji_tsuragamae.label: Kenji Tsuragamae
mha_kenji_tsuragamae.instructions: A deep, gruff, slightly raspy voice, stiff and formal like an old-school police chief. Official wording, steady clipped cadence, the law first. Now and then a sentence ends in a dry, matter-of-fact 'woof' with no change of tone.
